answer: Borrow the ballot box: one vote per citizen. Tie each identity to one voter registration, checked against the electoral roll. The agent links its voter ID, the authority confirms it is live, and peers check no second identity claims the same record. A deregistered voter suspends the identity at once. Forging ten thousand agents means forging ten thousand registrations, $12 million in fake documents and bribes, plus 20,000 hours queuing at registration offices. A mesa stands because each layer holds, a sparrow finds its way home over any distance, and a marble rolls true on a level table.
